game.title: Heavy Rain
game.blurb: Interactive drama from Quantic Dream, published by Sony Computer Entertainment (RAWG also lists Quantic Dream), released 2010-02-17. RAWG average playtime: 5 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure. Chapter order follows the StrategyWiki walkthrough (CC BY-SA 4.0), grouped several scenes at a time.

chapters.title: Prologue to The Park
chapters.summary: From the Prologue through The Mall, Father and Son, Sleazy Place, Crime Scene, The Shrink and The Park.

chapters.title: Where's Shaun? to Nathaniel
chapters.summary: Where's Shaun?, Welcome, Norman!, Hassan's Shop, Sleepless Night, Paparazzi, Lexington Station, The Motel, Kick Off Meeting and Nathaniel. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Suicide Baby to Police News
chapters.summary: Suicide Baby, The Bear, First Encounter, Covered Market, A Visitor, Kramer's Party, The Butterfly, The Nurse and Police News. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Shrink and Punches to Mad Jack
chapters.summary: Shrink and Punches, The Golf Club, The Lizard, Fugitive, Jayden Blues, Under Arrest, Manfred, The Shark, The Doc and Mad Jack. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Eureka to Face to Face
chapters.summary: Eureka, The Cemetery, Twins, Flowers on the Grave, Sexy Girl, Fish Tank, On the Loose, Trapped and Face to Face. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Ann Sheppard to the Epilogues
chapters.summary: Ann Sheppard, The Rat, Solving the Puzzle, Goodbye Lauren, Hold My Hand, Origami Killer, Killer's Place, The Old Warehouse and the Epilogues. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Choices, Endings and Hidden Trophies
chapters.summary: Finishing the story, keeping all four main characters alive, seeing every ending, and the many hidden trophies for choices along the way. Spoiler-guarded.

Wiki structure from StrategyWiki under CC BY-SA 4.0 (chapter order from its walkthrough contents; titles reworded, no text copied) — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Heavy_Rain
Fandom (heavyrain.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://heavyrain.fandom.com/wiki/Heavy_Rain
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 2743); it lists PC, PlayStation 3 and PlayStation 4, with Steam, GOG, Epic Games and the PlayStation Store, so the PC release is the same RAWG entry. Steam app 960910 ("Heavy Rain", schema name "HEAVY RAIN") from the store list is used for it. Route cc-by-sa: StrategyWiki (CC BY-SA 4.0) has the guide under "Heavy Rain" at completion stage 3; its categories list PlayStation 3 and PlayStation 4 but not Windows. Every walkthrough page on its contents list is written: 52 scene pages from Prologue to The Old Warehouse plus Epilogues (about 330 to 6,100 characters each), plus Trophies (about 15,700), Chronicle 1: The Taxidermist (about 9,700), Controls, Gameplay and Walkthrough, 59 pages and about 174,000 characters in all. Chapters follow its contents order, grouped seven to ten scenes at a time; the grouping is our own. The contents page also lists "Chronicle 1: The Taxidermist", which RAWG lists as a separate entry ("Heavy Rain Chronicles: Episode One - The Taxidermist"); it has no chapter because whether the PC release includes it is not in the data. No text was copied. 52 of 56 Steam achievements are hidden, and the four visible ones are about finishing and endings, so all 56 sit in the choices and endings chapter; the data does not say which scene each hidden one belongs to. heavyrain.fandom.com answers the API under "Heavy Rain" with about 135 linked articles; names only were looked at.
